methodology.join: Applicant ID within the same disaster is a join key; multiple matching source applicants remain candidates until a recorded analyst choice. A project contributes once, regardless of the number of designated declaration areas.
methodology.amounts: Project cost, federal obligations, total obligations including administrative costs, and mitigation amounts are separate measures, each summed in exact integer USD cents. The measures are not added together. Missing, invalid and conflicting source values are counted explicitly. Negative adjustments remain negative.
methodology.scope: The saved portfolio filters this retained source edition. Source filters, dataset refresh observations and completion records travel with the original capture.
methodology.universe: Declaration and applicant registers include scoped source entities with zero selected obligated projects. County, category and amount filters select project activity; they do not remove the source entity from its register.
methodology.source: FEMA Public Assistance Funded Projects Details contains obligated projects. Pre-obligation projects are outside that dataset; source financial amounts represent obligations to grantees.
